agent_explanation: With no walls, body moves at high horizontal speed (~8.9 m/s). Substepped Euler integration advances position past arena boundary before collision/bounce is applied; at step 68 overshoot 0.126 within tolerance, at step 69 overshoot 0.179 exceeds 0.15 limit. Reducing velocity prevents overshoot, confirming cause is insufficient boundary collision handling for fast bodies relying on wall boxes.
